text: Tax season shouldn't mean digging through a whole year of receipts.
Duitful reads the spending you already track, and finds what may count as tax relief. Five spends, over four thousand ringgit, found on its own.
Then it estimates your refund: the tax you owe, against the P C B your employer already paid.
When new spending looks like a relief, it asks you once. Dental scaling? That counts as medical.
One tap to claim it, and it shows you what that saves.
Every claim keeps its receipt, encrypted, right on your phone, ready for the e-Filing deadline.
Each relief shows its limit, and how much room you have left.
And your refund is worked out line by line, so nothing is a mystery.
It checks in every November, and again before e-Filing opens, so nothing slips through.
Duitful. Find your tax refund. Free on the App Store and Google Play.
